name: LEK 8829
summary: LEK-8829, also known as desoxy-LEK-8842, is a non-selective monoamine receptor modulator of the ergoline family related to the psychedelic drug LSD which has been studied as a potential novel antipsychotic.

pharmacology.text: LEK-8829, also known as desoxy-LEK-8842, is a non-selective monoamine receptor modulator of the ergoline family related to the psychedelic drug LSD which has been studied as a potential novel antipsychotic. The drug acts as a dopamine D1 receptor agonist, dopamine D2 receptor antagonist, and serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptor antagonist, among other actions.

uses.text: LEK-8829, also known as desoxy-LEK-8842, is a non-selective monoamine receptor modulator of the ergoline family related to the psychedelic drug LSD which has been studied as a potential novel antipsychotic. It was developed by the Slovenian pharmaceutical company Lek Pharmaceuticals.
